public import heap = "./heap.qui"

void copy_object(heap.State &state, int number, heap.CollectionRecord &record, bool[] &copied, int[] &queue)
    if number == 0 or copied[number - 1]
        return
    copied[number - 1] = true
    state.objects[number - 1].address = state.top
    state.objects[number - 1].moves += 1
    heap.HeapObject object := state.objects[number - 1]
    state.top += object.size
    heap.add(&record.live, object)
    heap.add(&record.moved, object)
    queue = queue.append(number)

void collect(heap.State &state, int[] roots, int line, int request)
    heap.CollectionRecord record := heap.new_record(state, line, request, "copy")
    state.base = state.half - state.base
    state.top = state.base
    copied := array(#state.objects, fill = false)
    int[] queue := []
    record.work += int(#roots)
    for root := roots[]
        copy_object(&state, root, &record, &copied, &queue)
    position := 0
    while position < int(#queue)
        heap.HeapObject object := state.objects[queue[position] - 1]
        position += 1
        record.work += object.size + int(#object.fields)
        for child := object.fields[]
            copy_object(&state, child, &record, &copied, &queue)
    for: index < int(#state.objects)
        if state.objects[index].present and not copied[index]
            heap.add(&record.freed, state.objects[index])
            state.objects[index].present = false
    heap.finish(&state, &record)

public import marking = "./mark_sweep.qui"

marking.copying.heap.Block[] old_blocks(const marking.copying.heap.State state)
    return marking.copying.heap.free_blocks(marking.copying.heap.active(state), state.young, state.size)

void write_barrier(marking.copying.heap.State &state, int target, int value)
    if state.objects[target - 1].address < state.young
        return
    state.barriers += 1
    if value != 0 and state.objects[value - 1].address < state.young and not state.remembered[target - 1]
        state.remembered[target - 1] = true
        state.remembers += 1

bool evacuate(marking.copying.heap.State &state, int number, marking.copying.heap.CollectionRecord &record, bool[] &pending, int[] &queue)
    if number == 0 or not pending[number - 1]
        return true
    index := number - 1
    pending[index] = false
    state.objects[index].age += 1
    state.objects[index].moves += 1
    marking.copying.heap.HeapObject object := state.objects[index]
    if record.kind == "tenure" or record.kind == "full" or object.age >= state.promotion_age
        int address := marking.copying.heap.first_fit(old_blocks(state), object.size)
        if address < 0
            return false
        state.objects[index].address = address
        marking.copying.heap.add(&record.promoted, object)
    else
        state.objects[index].address = state.target
        state.target += object.size
    marking.copying.heap.add(&record.moved, object)
    if record.kind == "minor" or record.kind == "tenure"
        marking.copying.heap.add(&record.live, object)
    queue = queue.append(number)
    return true

bool evacuate_fields(marking.copying.heap.State &state, int[] fields, marking.copying.heap.CollectionRecord &record, bool[] &pending, int[] &queue)
    for child := fields[]
        if not evacuate(&state, child, &record, &pending, &queue)
            return false
    return true

bool collect(marking.copying.heap.State &state, int[] roots, int line, int request, string kind)
    marking.copying.heap.CollectionRecord record := marking.copying.heap.new_record(state, line, request, kind)
    if kind == "major" or kind == "full"
        marking.mark(&state, roots, &record)
        for: index < int(#state.objects)
            marking.copying.heap.HeapObject object := state.objects[index]
            if not object.present or object.address < state.young
                continue
            record.work += 1
            if not object.marked
                state.objects[index].present = false
                state.remembered[index] = false
                marking.copying.heap.add(&record.freed, object)
    pending := [for object := state.objects[] then object.present and object.address < state.young]
    int destination := state.half - state.base
    state.target = destination
    int[] queue := []
    record.work += int(#roots)
    for root := roots[]
        if not evacuate(&state, root, &record, &pending, &queue)
            return false
    marking.copying.heap.HeapObject[] remembered := []
    for: index < int(#state.objects)
        if state.remembered[index]
            remembered = remembered.append(state.objects[index])
    for object := marking.copying.heap.by_address(remembered)[]
        record.work += 1 + int(#object.fields)
        if not evacuate_fields(&state, object.fields, &record, &pending, &queue)
            return false
    position := 0
    while position < int(#queue)
        marking.copying.heap.HeapObject object := state.objects[queue[position] - 1]
        position += 1
        record.work += object.size + int(#object.fields)
        if not evacuate_fields(&state, object.fields, &record, &pending, &queue)
            return false
    for: index < int(#state.objects)
        if pending[index]
            marking.copying.heap.add(&record.freed, state.objects[index])
            state.objects[index].present = false
    state.base = destination
    state.top = state.target
    state.remembered = array(#state.objects, fill = false)
    for: index < int(#state.objects)
        marking.copying.heap.HeapObject object := state.objects[index]
        if not object.present or object.address < state.young
            continue
        for child := object.fields[]
            if child != 0 and state.objects[child - 1].address < state.young
                state.remembered[index] = true
                break
    marking.copying.heap.finish(&state, &record)
    return true

bool allocate(marking.copying.heap.State &state, int[] roots, marking.copying.heap.HeapObject object, int line)
    for: attempt < 3
        if state.top + object.size <= state.base + state.half
            marking.copying.heap.place(&state, object, state.top)
            state.top += object.size
            return true
        if attempt == 2
            return false
        scarce := marking.copying.heap.largest_free(old_blocks(state)) < state.top - state.base
        kind := if attempt == 0 then (if scarce then "major" else "minor") else (if scarce then "full" else "tenure")
        if not collect(&state, roots, line, object.size, kind)
            return false
    return false

import math

class HeapObject(int number, local int pointers, local int data)
    size := 1 + pointers + data
    fields := array(nat(pointers), fill = 0)
    address := 0
    marked := false
    moves := 0
    age := 0
    count := 0
    present := true

class Pair()
    count := 0
    words := 0

    string text()
        return "{count} {words}"

void add(Pair &pair, HeapObject object)
    pair.count += 1
    pair.words += object.size

void add_pair(Pair &pair, Pair other)
    pair.count += other.count
    pair.words += other.words

class Block(int address, int length)
class FreeSummary(int total, int largest)

class CollectionRecord(int number, int line, int request, string kind, FreeSummary before)
    live := Pair()
    freed := Pair()
    moved := Pair()
    promoted := Pair()
    stack := 0
    work := 0
    after := FreeSummary(0, 0)

class State(int size, string algorithm, young := 0, promotion_age := 0)
    int half := (if algorithm == "GENERATIONAL" then young else size) / 2
    base := 0
    top := 0
    target := 0
    HeapObject[] objects := []
    CollectionRecord[] records := []
    bool[] remembered := []
    barriers := 0
    remembers := 0

HeapObject[] active(const State state)
    return [for object := state.objects[] if object.present then object]

HeapObject[] by_address(HeapObject[] objects)
    HeapObject[] result := []
    for object := objects[]
        position := int(#result)
        result = result.append(object)
        while position > 0 and object.address < result[position - 1].address
            result[position] = result[position - 1]
            position -= 1
        result[position] = object
    return result

Block[] free_blocks(HeapObject[] objects, int start, int end_address)
    Block[] blocks := []
    position := start
    for object := by_address(objects)[]
        if object.address < start or object.address >= end_address
            continue
        if object.address > position
            blocks = blocks.append(Block(position, object.address - position))
        position = object.address + object.size
    if position < end_address
        blocks = blocks.append(Block(position, end_address - position))
    return blocks

int first_fit(Block[] blocks, int size)
    for block := blocks[]
        if block.length >= size
            return block.address
    return -1

int total_free(Block[] blocks)
    total := 0
    for block := blocks[]
        total += block.length
    return total

int largest_free(Block[] blocks)
    largest := 0
    for block := blocks[]
        largest = math.max(largest, block.length)
    return largest

Block[] free_list(const State state)
    if state.algorithm == "MARK_COMPACT"
        return if state.top < state.size then [Block(state.top, state.size - state.top)] else []
    if state.algorithm == "COPYING" or state.algorithm == "GENERATIONAL"
        Block[] blocks := []
        if state.top < state.base + state.half
            blocks = blocks.append(Block(state.top, state.base + state.half - state.top))
        if state.algorithm == "GENERATIONAL"
            blocks = blocks.concat(free_blocks(active(state), state.young, state.size))
        return blocks
    return free_blocks(active(state), 0, state.size)

CollectionRecord new_record(const State state, int line, int request, string kind)
    blocks := free_list(state)
    return CollectionRecord(int(#state.records) + 1, line, request, kind, FreeSummary(total_free(blocks), largest_free(blocks)))

void finish(State &state, CollectionRecord &record)
    blocks := free_list(state)
    record.after = FreeSummary(total_free(blocks), largest_free(blocks))
    state.records = state.records.append(record)

void place(State &state, HeapObject object, int address)
    placed := object
    placed.address = address
    state.objects = state.objects.append(placed)
    state.remembered = state.remembered.append(false)

string dec2(int numerator, int denominator)
    rounded := (200 * numerator + denominator) / (2 * denominator)
    whole := rounded / 100
    part := rounded % 100
    return "{whole}.{part:02.}"

string pct(int part, int whole)
    return if whole == 0 then "-" else dec2(100 * part, whole)

string class_table(int[] values)
    counts := array(5, fill = 0)
    for value := values[]
        index := if value == 1 then 0 elif value <= 3 then 1 elif value <= 7 then 2 elif value <= 15 then 3 else 4
        counts[index] += 1
    return "1:{counts[0]} 2-3:{counts[1]} 4-7:{counts[2]} 8-15:{counts[3]} 16+:{counts[4]}"

string heap_map(const State state, bool[] reachable)
    cells := array(nat(state.size), fill = ".")
    if state.algorithm == "COPYING" or state.algorithm == "GENERATIONAL"
        start := state.half - state.base
        for: start <= address < start + state.half
            cells[address] = "-"
    for object := active(state)[]
        header := "#"
        body := "="
        if reachable[object.number - 1]
            letter := (object.number - 1) % 26
            header = "ABCDEFGHIJKLMNOPQRSTUVWXYZ"[letter]
            body = "abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz"[letter]
        cells[object.address] = header
        for: object.address + 1 <= address < object.address + object.size
            cells[address] = body
    return cells.join("")

import math
import mutator = "./mutator.qui"
import generational = "./generational.qui"

bool contains(string[] values, string target)
    for value := values[]
        if value == target
            return true
    return false

int used_words(generational.marking.copying.heap.HeapObject[] objects)
    words := 0
    for object := objects[]
        words += object.size
    return words

generational.marking.copying.heap.Pair pair_of(generational.marking.copying.heap.HeapObject[] objects)
    result := generational.marking.copying.heap.Pair()
    for object := objects[]
        generational.marking.copying.heap.add(&result, object)
    return result

bool[] reachable_objects(int[] roots, generational.marking.copying.heap.HeapObject[] objects)
    result := array(#objects, fill = false)
    stack := [for root := roots[] if root != 0 then root]
    while #stack != 0
        number := stack[-1]
        stack = stack[0:<#stack - 1]
        if result[number - 1]
            continue
        result[number - 1] = true
        for child := objects[number - 1].fields[]
            if child != 0
                stack = stack.append(child)
    return result

string fragmentation(generational.marking.copying.heap.Block[] blocks)
    int total := generational.marking.copying.heap.total_free(blocks)
    return generational.marking.copying.heap.pct(total - generational.marking.copying.heap.largest_free(blocks), total)

class Fault(int line, string reason)
class Checkpoint(string label, int line, int stack, generational.marking.copying.heap.Pair live, generational.marking.copying.heap.Pair allocated, generational.marking.copying.heap.Pair phase, generational.marking.copying.heap.Pair survivors, bool[] reachable)

class Script()
    line_count := 0
    mutator.Command[] commands := []
    Fault[] faults := []
    names := ["ALLOC", "PUSH", "LOAD", "POP", "SET", "OVERWRITE", "CHECKPOINT"]
    counts := array(7, fill = 0)
    int[] roots := []
    generational.marking.copying.heap.HeapObject[] objects := []
    int[] births := []
    int[] deaths := []
    int[] lifetimes := []
    clock := 0
    bool[] alive := []
    live := generational.marking.copying.heap.Pair()
    peak := generational.marking.copying.heap.Pair()
    peak_line := -1
    Checkpoint[] checkpoints := []
    string[] labels := []
    phase_start := 0

    int value(int source)
        return if source < 0 then 0 else roots[source]

    string check(mutator.Command command)
        name := command.name
        depth := int(#roots)
        if (name == "ALLOC" or name == "PUSH" or name == "LOAD") and depth == 64
            return "stack"
        if (name == "LOAD" or name == "SET" or name == "OVERWRITE") and command.slot >= depth
            return "stack"
        if (name == "PUSH" or name == "SET" or name == "OVERWRITE") and command.source >= depth
            return "stack"
        if name == "POP" and command.count > depth
            return "stack"
        if name == "LOAD" or name == "SET"
            target := roots[command.slot]
            if target == 0
                return "null"
            if command.field >= int(#objects[target - 1].fields)
                return "field"
        if name == "CHECKPOINT" and contains(labels, command.label)
            return "duplicate"
        return ""

    void .execute(mutator.Command command)
        name := command.name
        if name == "ALLOC"
            object := generational.marking.copying.heap.HeapObject(int(#objects) + 1, command.pointers, command.data)
            objects = objects.append(object)
            births = births.append(clock)
            deaths = deaths.append(-1)
            lifetimes = lifetimes.append(-1)
            clock += object.size
            roots = roots.append(object.number)
        elif name == "PUSH"
            roots = roots.append(value(command.source))
        elif name == "LOAD"
            roots = roots.append(objects[roots[command.slot] - 1].fields[command.field])
        elif name == "POP"
            roots = roots[0:<int(#roots) - command.count]
        elif name == "SET"
            objects[roots[command.slot] - 1].fields[command.field] = value(command.source)
        elif name == "OVERWRITE"
            roots[command.slot] = value(command.source)

    void .analyze(string[] lines)
        line_count = int(#lines)
        for: index < line_count
            parsed := mutator.parse_line(index + 1, lines[index])
            reason := parsed.reason
            mutator.Command command := parsed.command
            if reason == ""
                reason = check(command)
            if reason != ""
                faults = faults.append(Fault(index + 1, reason))
                continue
            commands = commands.append(command)
            for: kind < 7
                if names[kind] == command.name
                    counts[kind] += 1
            .execute(command)
            reached := reachable_objects(roots, objects)
            for: number < int(#alive)
                if alive[number] and not reached[number]
                    deaths[number] = command.line
                    lifetimes[number] = clock - births[number] - objects[number].size
            alive = reached
            live = generational.marking.copying.heap.Pair()
            for: number < int(#objects)
                if reached[number]
                    generational.marking.copying.heap.add(&live, objects[number])
            if peak_line < 0 or live.words > peak.words
                peak = live
                peak_line = command.line
            if command.name == "CHECKPOINT"
                labels = labels.append(command.label)
                phase := generational.marking.copying.heap.Pair()
                survivors := generational.marking.copying.heap.Pair()
                for: phase_start <= number < int(#objects)
                    generational.marking.copying.heap.add(&phase, objects[number])
                    if reached[number]
                        generational.marking.copying.heap.add(&survivors, objects[number])
                phase_start = int(#objects)
                checkpoints = checkpoints.append(Checkpoint(command.label, command.line, int(#roots), live, pair_of(objects), phase, survivors, reached))

    string[] report()
        lines := ["script lines {line_count} valid {#commands} errors {#faults}"]
        for fault := faults[]
            lines = lines.append("error line {fault.line} {fault.reason}")
        lines = lines.append("commands " + [for index := (0:<7)[] then names[index] + " {counts[index]}"].join(" "))
        int[] sizes := [for object := objects[] then object.size]
        lines = lines.concat(["allocated objects {#objects} words {used_words(objects)} sizes " + generational.marking.copying.heap.class_table(sizes), "peak_live objects {peak.count} words {peak.words} line {peak_line}", "end_live objects {live.count} words {live.words} stack {#roots}"])
        life_counts := array(6, fill = 0)
        for lifetime := lifetimes[]
            group := if lifetime < 0 then 5 elif lifetime <= 63 then 0 elif lifetime <= 255 then 1 elif lifetime <= 1023 then 2 elif lifetime <= 4095 then 3 else 4
            life_counts[group] += 1
        lines = lines.append("lifetimes 0-63 {life_counts[0]} 64-255 {life_counts[1]} 256-1023 {life_counts[2]} 1024-4095 {life_counts[3]} 4096+ {life_counts[4]} live {life_counts[5]}")
        for checkpoint := checkpoints[]
            lines = lines.append("checkpoint {checkpoint.label} line {checkpoint.line} stack {checkpoint.stack} live " + checkpoint.live.text() + " allocated " + checkpoint.allocated.text() + " phase " + checkpoint.phase.text() + " survivors " + checkpoint.survivors.text() + " survival " + generational.marking.copying.heap.pct(checkpoint.survivors.words, checkpoint.phase.words))
        return lines

bool on_cycle(int number, bool[] members, generational.marking.copying.heap.HeapObject[] objects)
    visited := array(#objects, fill = false)
    int[] stack := [for child := objects[number - 1].fields[] if child != 0 and members[child - 1] then child]
    while #stack != 0
        current := stack[-1]
        stack = stack[0:<#stack - 1]
        if current == number
            return true
        if visited[current - 1]
            continue
        visited[current - 1] = true
        for child := objects[current - 1].fields[]
            if child != 0 and members[child - 1]
                stack = stack.append(child)
    return false

string[] leak_report(string title, generational.marking.copying.heap.HeapObject[] garbage, int[] deaths, generational.marking.copying.heap.HeapObject[] objects)
    members := array(#objects, fill = false)
    int[][] neighbors := array(#objects, fill = [])
    for object := garbage[]
        members[object.number - 1] = true
    for object := garbage[]
        for child := object.fields[]
            if child != 0 and members[child - 1]
                neighbors[object.number - 1] = neighbors[object.number - 1].append(child)
                neighbors[child - 1] = neighbors[child - 1].append(object.number)
    grouped := array(#objects, fill = false)
    int[][] groups := []
    for: index < int(#objects)
        if not members[index] or grouped[index]
            continue
        grouped[index] = true
        stack := [index + 1]
        int[] group := []
        while #stack != 0
            current := stack[-1]
            stack = stack[0:<#stack - 1]
            group = group.append(current)
            for other := neighbors[current - 1][]
                if not grouped[other - 1]
                    grouped[other - 1] = true
                    stack = stack.append(other)
        groups = groups.append(group.sorted())
    lines := ["{title} groups {#groups} objects {#garbage} words {used_words(garbage)}"]
    for: index < int(#groups)
        group := groups[index]
        string[] ids := []
        cycles := 0
        died := 0
        words := 0
        for number := group[]
            cyclic := on_cycle(number, members, objects)
            ids = ids.append("{number}" + (if cyclic then "*" else ""))
            if cyclic
                cycles += 1
            died = math.max(died, deaths[number - 1])
            words += objects[number - 1].size
        lines = lines.append("group {index + 1} objects {#group} words {words} cycle {cycles} died {died} ids " + ids.join(" "))
    return lines

class Pause(int line, int work, int freed, bool collection)
class Cascade(int line, generational.marking.copying.heap.Pair freed, int work)
class PauseStats(local Pause[] pauses)
    count := int(#pauses)
    collections := 0
    work := 0
    freed := 0
    maximum := 0
    local int[] works := []
    for pause := pauses[]
        if pause.collection
            collections += 1
        work += pause.work
        freed += pause.freed
        maximum = math.max(maximum, pause.work)
        works = works.append(pause.work)
    works = works.sorted()
    string p50 := if count == 0 then "-" else "{works[(50 * count + 99) / 100 - 1]}"
    string p90 := if count == 0 then "-" else "{works[(90 * count + 99) / 100 - 1]}"

class Segment(int start, int length, bool is_mutator, int before)
class Timeline()
    Segment[] segments := []
    length := 0
    mutator_units := 0

    void .add(bool flag, int units)
        if units == 0
            return
        last := int(#segments) - 1
        if last >= 0 and segments[last].is_mutator == flag
            segments[last].length += units
        else
            segments = segments.append(Segment(length, units, flag, mutator_units))
        length += units
        if flag
            mutator_units += units

    int until_position(int position)
        low := 0
        high := int(#segments) - 1
        while low < high
            middle := (low + high + 1) / 2
            if segments[middle].start <= position
                low = middle
            else
                high = middle - 1
        segment := segments[low]
        return segment.before + (if segment.is_mutator then position - segment.start else 0)

    string mmu(int width)
        if width > length
            return "-"
        lowest := width
        for segment := segments[]
            for begin := [segment.start, segment.start + segment.length - width][]
                if begin >= 0 and begin <= length - width
                    lowest = math.min(lowest, until_position(begin + width) - until_position(begin))
        return generational.marking.copying.heap.pct(lowest, width)

class Run(mutator.CollectorEntry entry, mutator.Config config, Script script)
    collector := generational.marking.copying.heap.State(config.heap_size, entry.algorithm, entry.young, entry.age)
    int[] roots := []
    Cascade[] cascades := []
    string[][] reports := []
    string[][] observations := []
    timeline := Timeline()
    peak_used := 0
    failed_line := -1
    failed_size := 0
    increments := 0
    decrements := 0
    generational.marking.copying.heap.HeapObject[] released := []

    int value(int source)
        return if source < 0 then 0 else roots[source]

    void .retain(int number)
        if entry.algorithm == "REFCOUNT" and number != 0
            collector.objects[number - 1].count += 1
            increments += 1

    void .release(int number)
        if entry.algorithm != "REFCOUNT" or number == 0
            return
        collector.objects[number - 1].count -= 1
        decrements += 1
        if collector.objects[number - 1].count > 0
            return
        pending := [number]
        while #pending != 0
            current := pending[-1]
            pending = pending[0:<#pending - 1]
            generational.marking.copying.heap.HeapObject object := collector.objects[current - 1]
            collector.objects[current - 1].present = false
            released = released.append(object)
            for child := object.fields[]
                if child == 0
                    continue
                decrements += 1
                collector.objects[child - 1].count -= 1
                if collector.objects[child - 1].count == 0
                    pending = pending.append(child)

    void .push(int number)
        .retain(number)
        roots = roots.append(number)

    void .backup(int line, int request)
        generational.marking.copying.heap.CollectionRecord record := generational.marking.copying.heap.new_record(collector, line, request, "backup")
        generational.marking.mark(&collector, roots, &record)
        generational.marking.copying.heap.HeapObject[] garbage := [for object := generational.marking.copying.heap.active(collector)[] if not object.marked then object]
        reports = reports.append(leak_report("backup {record.number} line {line}", garbage, script.deaths, collector.objects))
        generational.marking.sweep(&collector, &record)
        for object := garbage[]
            for child := object.fields[]
                if child != 0 and collector.objects[child - 1].marked
                    collector.objects[child - 1].count -= 1
                    decrements += 1
        generational.marking.copying.heap.finish(&collector, &record)

    bool .allocate(generational.marking.copying.heap.HeapObject object, int line)
        if entry.algorithm == "GENERATIONAL"
            return generational.allocate(&collector, roots, object, line)
        address := -1
        if entry.algorithm == "MARK_COMPACT" or entry.algorithm == "COPYING"
            int finish := if entry.algorithm == "MARK_COMPACT" then collector.size else collector.base + collector.half
            if collector.top + object.size > finish
                if entry.algorithm == "COPYING"
                    generational.marking.copying.collect(&collector, roots, line, object.size)
                else
                    generational.marking.collect(&collector, roots, line, object.size)
                finish = if entry.algorithm == "MARK_COMPACT" then collector.size else collector.base + collector.half
            if collector.top + object.size > finish
                return false
            address = collector.top
            collector.top += object.size
        else
            address = generational.marking.copying.heap.first_fit(generational.marking.copying.heap.free_list(collector), object.size)
            if address < 0
                if entry.algorithm == "REFCOUNT"
                    .backup(line, object.size)
                else
                    generational.marking.collect(&collector, roots, line, object.size)
                address = generational.marking.copying.heap.first_fit(generational.marking.copying.heap.free_list(collector), object.size)
            if address < 0
                return false
        generational.marking.copying.heap.place(&collector, object, address)
        return true

    string[] observe(Checkpoint checkpoint)
        generational.marking.copying.heap.HeapObject[] objects := generational.marking.copying.heap.active(collector)
        live := generational.marking.copying.heap.Pair()
        garbage := generational.marking.copying.heap.Pair()
        pointers := 0
        forward := 0
        backward := 0
        distance := 0
        for object := objects[]
            if not checkpoint.reachable[object.number - 1]
                generational.marking.copying.heap.add(&garbage, object)
                continue
            generational.marking.copying.heap.add(&live, object)
            for child := object.fields[]
                if child == 0
                    continue
                int address := collector.objects[child - 1].address
                pointers += 1
                int difference := address - object.address
                distance += math.abs(difference)
                if address > object.address
                    forward += 1
                elif address < object.address
                    backward += 1
        generational.marking.copying.heap.Block[] blocks := generational.marking.copying.heap.free_list(collector)
        string mean := if pointers == 0 then "-" else generational.marking.copying.heap.dec2(distance, pointers)
        string[] lines := ["heap objects " + pair_of(objects).text() + " reachable " + live.text() + " garbage " + garbage.text(), "free total {generational.marking.copying.heap.total_free(blocks)} largest {generational.marking.copying.heap.largest_free(blocks)} blocks {#blocks} sizes " + generational.marking.copying.heap.class_table([for block := blocks[] then block.length]) + " fragmentation " + fragmentation(blocks), "locality pointers {pointers} forward {forward} backward {backward} mean_distance {mean}"]
        if entry.algorithm == "GENERATIONAL"
            young := generational.marking.copying.heap.Pair()
            old := generational.marking.copying.heap.Pair()
            ages := array(4, fill = 0)
            for object := objects[]
                if object.address < collector.young
                    generational.marking.copying.heap.add(&young, object)
                    int age_group := if object.age < 3 then object.age else 3
                    ages[age_group] += 1
                else
                    generational.marking.copying.heap.add(&old, object)
            remembered := 0
            for member := collector.remembered[]
                if member
                    remembered += 1
            lines = lines.append("generations young " + young.text() + " old " + old.text() + " remembered {remembered} ages 0:{ages[0]} 1:{ages[1]} 2:{ages[2]} 3+:{ages[3]}")
        if contains(config.maps, checkpoint.label)
            string text := generational.marking.copying.heap.heap_map(collector, checkpoint.reachable)
            for: 0 <= start < int(#text) step config.width
                lines = lines.append("{start:04.} " + text[start:<start + config.width])
        return lines

    void .execute(mutator.Command command)
        name := command.name
        if name == "PUSH"
            .push(value(command.source))
        elif name == "LOAD"
            .push(collector.objects[roots[command.slot] - 1].fields[command.field])
        elif name == "POP"
            for _ < command.count
                previous := roots[-1]
                roots = roots[0:<#roots - 1]
                .release(previous)
        elif name == "SET"
            target := roots[command.slot]
            int next_value := value(command.source)
            if entry.algorithm == "GENERATIONAL"
                generational.write_barrier(&collector, target, next_value)
            .retain(next_value)
            int previous := collector.objects[target - 1].fields[command.field]
            collector.objects[target - 1].fields[command.field] = next_value
            .release(previous)
        elif name == "OVERWRITE"
            int next_value := value(command.source)
            .retain(next_value)
            previous := roots[command.slot]
            roots[command.slot] = next_value
            .release(previous)
        elif name == "CHECKPOINT"
            observations = observations.append(observe(script.checkpoints[#observations]))

    void .simulate()
        for command := script.commands[]
            previous := int(#collector.records)
            placed := true
            units := 1
            if command.name == "ALLOC"
                object := generational.marking.copying.heap.HeapObject(int(#collector.objects) + 1, command.pointers, command.data)
                placed = .allocate(object, command.line)
                units = object.size
                if placed
                    .push(object.number)
                    peak_used = math.max(peak_used, used_words(generational.marking.copying.heap.active(collector)))
            else
                .execute(command)
            for index := (previous:<int(#collector.records))[]
                .timeline.add(false, collector.records[index].work)
            if not placed
                failed_line = command.line
                failed_size = units
                return
            .timeline.add(true, units)
            if #released > 0
                work := 0
                for object := released[]
                    work += 1 + int(#object.fields)
                cascades = cascades.append(Cascade(command.line, pair_of(released), work))
                .timeline.add(false, work)
                released = []
        if entry.algorithm == "REFCOUNT"
            generational.marking.copying.heap.HeapObject[] garbage := [for object := generational.marking.copying.heap.active(collector)[] if not script.alive[object.number - 1] then object]
            reports = reports.append(leak_report("end", garbage, script.deaths, collector.objects))

    Pause[] pauses()
        result := [for record := collector.records[] then Pause(record.line, record.work, record.freed.words, true)]
        return result.concat([for cascade := cascades[] then Pause(cascade.line, cascade.work, cascade.freed.words, false)])

    string[] collection_lines()
        lines := ["collector {entry.name} {entry.algorithm}"]
        for record := collector.records[]
            lines = lines.append("{record.number} line {record.line} size {record.request} kind {record.kind} live " + record.live.text() + " freed " + record.freed.text() + " moved " + record.moved.text() + " promoted " + record.promoted.text() + " stack {record.stack} work {record.work} before {record.before.total} {record.before.largest} after {record.after.total} {record.after.largest}")
        Pause[] all_pauses := pauses()
        stats := PauseStats(all_pauses)
        lines = lines.append("totals collections {stats.collections} pauses {stats.count} work {stats.work} freed {stats.freed} pause p50 {stats.p50} p90 {stats.p90} max {stats.maximum}")
        string[] windows := [for width := config.windows[] then "{width}:" + timeline.mmu(width)]
        lines = lines.append("utilization " + generational.marking.copying.heap.pct(timeline.mutator_units, timeline.length) + " mmu " + windows.join(" "))
        if entry.algorithm == "GENERATIONAL"
            parts := ["generational"]
            promoted := generational.marking.copying.heap.Pair()
            for kind := ["minor", "major", "tenure", "full"][]
                count := 0
                work := 0
                for record := collector.records[]
                    if record.kind == kind
                        count += 1
                        work += record.work
                parts = parts.append("{kind} {count} {work}")
            for record := collector.records[]
                generational.marking.copying.heap.add_pair(&promoted, record.promoted)
            parts = parts.append("promoted " + promoted.text() + " barrier {collector.barriers} remembered {collector.remembers}")
            lines = lines.append(parts.join(" "))
        elif entry.algorithm == "REFCOUNT"
            freed := generational.marking.copying.heap.Pair()
            largest := -1
            for: index < int(#cascades)
                generational.marking.copying.heap.add_pair(&freed, cascades[index].freed)
                if largest < 0 or cascades[index].work > cascades[largest].work
                    largest = index
            maximum := "max_cascade 0 0 line -"
            if largest >= 0
                cascade := cascades[largest]
                maximum = "max_cascade {cascade.freed.count} {cascade.work} line {cascade.line}"
            lines = lines.append("refcount increments {increments} decrements {decrements} cascades {#cascades} freed " + freed.text() + " " + maximum)
        previous := 0
        for checkpoint := script.checkpoints[]
            if failed_line >= 0 and failed_line < checkpoint.line
                lines = lines.append("phase {checkpoint.label} out_of_memory")
            else
                phase := PauseStats([for pause := all_pauses[] if previous < pause.line <= checkpoint.line then pause])
                lines = lines.append("phase {checkpoint.label} collections {phase.collections} pauses {phase.count} work {phase.work} freed {phase.freed} max_pause {phase.maximum}")
            previous = checkpoint.line
        return lines.append(if failed_line < 0 then "status completed" else "status out_of_memory line {failed_line} size {failed_size}")

    string summary()
        stats := PauseStats(pauses())
        live := 0
        moved := 0
        moved_objects := 0
        max_moves := 0
        for record := collector.records[]
            live += record.live.count
            moved += record.moved.count
        for object := collector.objects[]
            if object.moves > 0
                moved_objects += 1
                max_moves = math.max(max_moves, object.moves)
        status := if failed_line < 0 then "completed" else "out_of_memory"
        values := [entry.name, entry.algorithm, status, "{#collector.records}", "{stats.count}", "{live}", "{moved}", "{moved_objects}", "{max_moves}", "{stats.freed}", "{stats.work}", stats.p50, stats.p90, "{stats.maximum}", "{peak_used}"]
        if failed_line >= 0
            values = values.concat(["-", "-", "-", "-"])
        else
            generational.marking.copying.heap.Block[] blocks := generational.marking.copying.heap.free_list(collector)
            values = values.concat(["{used_words(generational.marking.copying.heap.active(collector))}", "{generational.marking.copying.heap.total_free(blocks)}", "{generational.marking.copying.heap.largest_free(blocks)}", fragmentation(blocks)])
        return values.join(",")

string[] join_blocks(string[][] blocks)
    string[] lines := []
    for block := blocks[]
        if #lines > 0
            lines = lines.append("")
        lines = lines.concat(block)
    return lines

void write_lines(string name, string[] lines)
    writer1 := file.write("output/" + name)
    .writer1(if #lines == 0 then "" else lines.join(NL) + NL)

config := mutator.read_config("input/config.txt")
script := Script()
.script.analyze(mutator.read_lines("input/mutator.txt"))
Run[] runs := []
for entry := config.collectors[]
    simulation := Run(entry, config, script)
    .simulation.simulate()
    runs = runs.append(simulation)
string[][] map_blocks := []
for: index < int(#script.checkpoints)
    checkpoint := script.checkpoints[index]
    for simulation := runs[]
        lines := ["checkpoint {checkpoint.label} line {checkpoint.line} collector {simulation.entry.name}"]
        lines = lines.concat(if index < int(#simulation.observations) then simulation.observations[index] else ["out_of_memory"])
        map_blocks = map_blocks.append(lines)
collection_blocks := [for simulation := runs[] then simulation.collection_lines()]
string[] summary := ["collector,type,status,collections,pauses,live,moved,moved_objects,max_moves,freed,total_work,p50_pause,p90_pause,max_pause,peak_used,end_used,end_free,largest_free,fragmentation"].concat([for simulation := runs[] then simulation.summary()])
string[][] leak_blocks := []
for simulation := runs[]
    if simulation.entry.algorithm == "REFCOUNT"
        lines := ["collector {simulation.entry.name}"]
        for report := simulation.reports[]
            lines = lines.concat(report)
        if simulation.failed_line >= 0
            lines = lines.append("status out_of_memory")
        leak_blocks = leak_blocks.append(lines)
bool output_exists := file.is_directory("output")
if not output_exists
    file.mkdir("output")
write_lines("mutator.txt", script.report())
write_lines("heap_maps.txt", join_blocks(map_blocks))
write_lines("collections.txt", join_blocks(collection_blocks))
write_lines("summary.csv", summary)
write_lines("leaks.txt", if #leak_blocks == 0 then ["none"] else join_blocks(leak_blocks))

import math

public import copying = "./copying.qui"

void push_mark(copying.heap.State &state, int[] &stack, int number, copying.heap.CollectionRecord &record)
    state.objects[number - 1].marked = true
    stack = stack.append(number)
    record.stack = math.max(record.stack, int(#stack))

void mark(copying.heap.State &state, int[] roots, copying.heap.CollectionRecord &record)
    for: index < int(#state.objects)
        if state.objects[index].present
            state.objects[index].marked = false
    record.work += int(#roots)
    int[] stack := []
    for root := roots[]
        if root == 0 or state.objects[root - 1].marked
            continue
        push_mark(&state, &stack, root, &record)
        while #stack != 0
            number := stack[-1]
            stack = stack[0:<#stack - 1]
            copying.heap.HeapObject object := state.objects[number - 1]
            copying.heap.add(&record.live, object)
            record.work += 1 + int(#object.fields)
            for child := object.fields[]
                if child != 0 and not state.objects[child - 1].marked
                    push_mark(&state, &stack, child, &record)

void sweep(copying.heap.State &state, copying.heap.CollectionRecord &record)
    for: index < int(#state.objects)
        if not state.objects[index].present
            continue
        record.work += 1
        if not state.objects[index].marked
            copying.heap.add(&record.freed, state.objects[index])
            state.objects[index].present = false

void collect(copying.heap.State &state, int[] roots, int line, int request)
    compact := state.algorithm == "MARK_COMPACT"
    copying.heap.CollectionRecord record := copying.heap.new_record(state, line, request, if compact then "compact" else "sweep")
    mark(&state, roots, &record)
    if not compact
        sweep(&state, &record)
    else
        copying.heap.HeapObject[] ordered := copying.heap.by_address(copying.heap.active(state))
        record.work += int(#ordered) + int(#roots)
        destination := 0
        for object := ordered[]
            int index := object.number - 1
            if not object.marked
                state.objects[index].present = false
                copying.heap.add(&record.freed, object)
                continue
            record.work += int(#object.fields)
            if object.address != destination
                copying.heap.add(&record.moved, object)
                record.work += object.size
                state.objects[index].address = destination
                state.objects[index].moves += 1
            destination += object.size
        state.top = destination
    copying.heap.finish(&state, &record)

class CollectorEntry(string name, string algorithm, young := 0, age := 0)
class Config(int heap_size, CollectorEntry[] collectors, string[] maps, int[] windows, int width)
class Command(int line, string name)
    pointers := 0
    data := 0
    slot := 0
    field := 0
    source := -1
    count := 0
    label := ""

string[] read_lines(string path)
    content := string.from_utf8(file.read_bin(path))
    lines := content.split(NL)
    return lines[0:<#lines - 1]

Config read_config(string path)
    heap_size := 0
    CollectorEntry[] collectors := []
    string[] maps := []
    int[] windows := []
    width := 0
    for line := read_lines(path)[]
        fields := line.split(" ")
        if fields[0] == "HEAP"
            heap_size = int(fields[1])
        elif fields[0] == "COLLECTOR"
            int young := if #fields > 3 then int(fields[3]) else 0
            int age := if #fields > 4 then int(fields[4]) else 0
            collectors = collectors.append(CollectorEntry(fields[1], fields[2], young, age))
        elif fields[0] == "MAPS"
            maps = fields[1:]
        elif fields[0] == "MMU"
            windows = [for value := fields[1:][] then int(value)]
        else
            width = int(fields[1])
    return Config(heap_size, collectors, maps, windows, width)

bool is_number(string token)
    if #token < 1 or #token > 4 or (#token > 1 and token[0] == "0")
        return false
    for: position < int(#token)
        character := token[position]
        if not "0123456789".contains(character)
            return false
    return true

bool is_label(string token)
    if #token < 1 or #token > 16
        return false
    for: position < int(#token)
        character := token[position]
        if not "abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz0123456789_".contains(character)
            return false
    return true

int source_value(string token)
    return if token == "-" then -1 else int(token)

class Parsed(Command command, string reason)

Parsed parse_line(int line, string text)
    tokens := text.split(" ")
    name := tokens[0]
    string[] form := []
    if name == "ALLOC" or name == "LOAD"
        form = ["number", "number"]
    elif name == "PUSH"
        form = ["source"]
    elif name == "POP"
        form = ["number"]
    elif name == "SET"
        form = ["number", "number", "source"]
    elif name == "OVERWRITE"
        form = ["number", "source"]
    elif name == "CHECKPOINT"
        form = ["label"]
    command := Command(line, name)
    if #form == 0 or #tokens != #form + 1
        return Parsed(command, "syntax")
    for: position < int(#form)
        token := tokens[position + 1]
        valid := if form[position] == "number" then is_number(token) elif form[position] == "source" then token == "-" or is_number(token) else is_label(token)
        if not valid
            return Parsed(command, "syntax")
    if name == "ALLOC"
        command.pointers = int(tokens[1])
        command.data = int(tokens[2])
    elif name == "PUSH"
        command.source = source_value(tokens[1])
    elif name == "LOAD"
        command.slot = int(tokens[1])
        command.field = int(tokens[2])
    elif name == "POP"
        command.count = int(tokens[1])
    elif name == "SET"
        command.slot = int(tokens[1])
        command.field = int(tokens[2])
        command.source = source_value(tokens[3])
    elif name == "OVERWRITE"
        command.slot = int(tokens[1])
        command.source = source_value(tokens[2])
    else
        command.label = tokens[1]
    if (name == "ALLOC" and (command.pointers > 6 or command.data > 24)) or (name == "POP" and command.count == 0)
        return Parsed(command, "range")
    return Parsed(command, "")
